scripts.build: pnpm --filter @lore/shared build && pnpm --filter @lore/api build && pnpm --filter @lore/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @lore/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @lore/shared build && pnpm --filter @lore/api build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @lore/shared build && pnpm --filter @lore/api build && LORE_E2E_BUILD=1 API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4321 APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4322 pnpm --filter @lore/web exec next build --webpack && playwright test
